protocol.recurrence: Validated QR-normalized standard blockCG with two local A-projections, auxiliary deflation, rank loss monitoring, every20/suspected model checks and final primary model check. Identity Schur preconditioner.
protocol.Gaussian_auxiliary: SeedSequence[0,6220,71,cycle], independently generated g scaled to||q||.
protocol.geometric_auxiliary: B=[q,mask*q], fixed median stable split along widest-range training feature. Scalar cutvalue/cutrow retained; transient mask freed before block loop.
protocol.stopping: Block relative rtol=(.5e-8||originalb||)/||q||. Full original1e-8 verification after each correction; maximum3 additional full-original correction cycles.
protocol.memory: Same1MiB owned-array plus64KiB reserve model; actual full-loop/IR trace gate. No rank shrink.
protocol.controls: Unchanged scalar wrapper with the same specializedFIRST8helper; unchanged original_exact416 code.
protocol.scope: Fixed standard block controls only; no adaptive partition or new principle claim.
